tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the profile of the currently authenticated MongoDB Atlas user including name and email.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Get detailed information about the current MongoDB Atlas organization including name, plan type, MFA status, and payment status.

tools.name: list_organization_members
tools.description: List all members of the current MongoDB Atlas organization with their roles, email, and last authentication time.

tools.name: list_organization_projects
tools.description: List all projects (groups) in the current MongoDB Atlas organization with cluster, user, and alert counts.

tools.name: list_organization_teams
tools.description: List all teams in the current MongoDB Atlas organization with member counts.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get detailed information about the current MongoDB Atlas project (group) from the URL context, including state, cluster count, and data size.

tools.name: list_clusters
tools.description: List all clusters in the current MongoDB Atlas project with their state, provider, region, instance size, and connection strings.

tools.name: get_cluster
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific MongoDB Atlas cluster by name, including state, version, provider, connection string, and disk size.

tools.name: list_database_users
tools.description: List all database users in the current MongoDB Atlas project with their roles, scopes, and authentication type.

tools.name: create_database_user
tools.description: Create a new database user in the current MongoDB Atlas project with specified roles and optional cluster scopes.

tools.name: delete_database_user
tools.description: Delete a database user from the current MongoDB Atlas project by username and authentication database.

tools.name: list_ip_access_list
tools.description: List all IP access list entries (IP whitelist) for the current MongoDB Atlas project.

tools.name: add_ip_access_entry
tools.description: Add an IP address or CIDR block to the access list for the current MongoDB Atlas project, allowing network access from that address.

tools.name: delete_ip_access_entry
tools.description: Remove an IP address or CIDR block from the access list for the current MongoDB Atlas project.

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: List all active alerts for the current MongoDB Atlas project including event type, status, and affected cluster.

tools.name: list_alert_configs
tools.description: List all alert configurations for the current MongoDB Atlas project including event type, enabled status, and alert type.

tools.name: list_network_peering
tools.description: List all network peering connections for the current MongoDB Atlas project including provider, status, VPC ID, and CIDR block.

tools.name: get_deployment_status
tools.description: Get the current deployment status for the MongoDB Atlas project including goal state, version conflicts, draft status, and in-progress jobs.

tools.name: get_billing_plan
tools.description: Get the billing plan for the current MongoDB Atlas organization including plan type, display name, and whether it is a paid plan.

tools.name: get_user_security
tools.description: Get the authentication security settings for the current MongoDB Atlas project including LDAP authentication, LDAP authorization, and custom X.509 certificate authority status.
